text:
Maya: Hey team :wave: heads-up — running a short ops thread for the Q3 SI mentor cohort. We need to finalize HW kit dispatch, mentor schedule, and certification windows. Targets: kits out week of Aug 9, mentor dry-run Aug 2–4, cert window Aug 16–20. Need final mentor list + shipping addresses by Tue EOD so logistics can print labels.

Devon: Quick Q — what's the kit contents and are there any export/customs declarations we should include? Some partners need ECCN on the paperwork.

Maya: Kit contents planned: dev kit (4x GPUs small board), spare power harness, USB keys with images, quickstart card, and a support contact card. For customs: include ECCN 5D002 where applicable and add this manifest to the box label.

Maya: ```
SKU,Qty,Description
RDW-HWKIT-01,1,Inference dev-kit (4x A100 style)
RDW-PSH-01,1,Power harness
RDW-USB-IMG,1,USB image with onboarding scripts
RDW-QS-01,1,Quickstart card + support contact
```

Liam: For international shipments, DHL gives better tracking in APAC, FedEx for EU/NA. We need PO number and cost center before we hand off to logistics. Also flagging that the vendor needs a 3-business-day lead for custom pallets. :truck:

Sasha: On certification: are proctored exams synchronous? We have mentors in EMEA/APAC — want to avoid midnight sessions. Can we do a 48-hour window with a proctoring link instead?

Priya: Marketplace/joint-announcement note — marketing wants the partner logos and a short blurb at least one week before the kit ships. Legal flagged one partner contract that requires a pre-announce review; I'll loop in legal if you share the partner list. Also, we need the feature flag name for the SI onboarding flow for the marketplace listing.

Maya: Good call. Proposal: cert is a 72-hour window per region with optional live proctor slots in UTC-friendly blocks: APAC (00:00–08:00 UTC), EMEA (06:00–18:00 UTC), NA (18:00–04:00 UTC). That should let mentors schedule localized proctor sessions.

Devon: Can we host mentor dry-runs as 2 x 90min sessions recorded + a live Q&A? I can prep a 20-min walkthrough of the hardware bringup script. Will share recordings for asynchronous mentors.

Maya: Yes — please record. Use the internal training repo for uploads. Link to proposed calendar blocks: https://calendar.redwood.com/si-mentor-dryrun (will share invite after we lock names).

Sasha: I can lead the tech walkthrough on Aug 2 @ 10:00 UTC. Need access to the lab VMs and a temporary IAM role. @Devon can you include the `lab-provision` snippet in your walkthrough?

Devon: Will include `lab-provision`. Snippet for the mentor to run: 

```bash
# quick provision (mentor)
redwoodctl lab provision --image si-mentor-2026 --size small --ssh-key /home/mentor/.ssh/id_rsa
redwoodctl lab status --wait
```

Liam: PO code will be RDW-SI-Q3-3321. I'll confirm cost center by EOD and upload invoice template to the logistics ticket.

ops-bot: [automation] hw-kit-dispatch job queued (job_id=hw-dispatch-177999) — estimate pickup: 2026-08-07.

Priya: Marketing: I'll need the partner one-liners by Thu so we can get creative review and lock the announcement embargo. Legal: loop me in if you see any contract redlines.

Maya: Great — action items:
- Devon: produce recorded walkthrough + `lab-provision` snippet (due Aug 1).
- Sasha: run live walkthrough and own mentor Q&A (Aug 2).
- Liam: confirm PO & cost center, coordinate carrier (due Tue EOD).
- Priya: collect partner blurbs and legal check (due Thu).
- Ops: labels + customs manifest printer will need final addresses Tue EOD.

Maya: I'll compile the mentor list now and ping everyone once it's live. Thanks :thumbsup: feel free to add any constraints or blockers here.

Liam: ack. Shipping note: add "Fragile — electronics" AND "Return to Redwood" on the outer box for RMA flows.

Sasha: I'll request the IAM role today and follow up here once the lab is ready.

Devon: Sounds good — recording plan in motion.

Priya: Will push marketing timeline into the channel and link the creative brief.

Maya: closing the loop — will update the calendar invites after Tue. :shipit:
